journal_style_gaps.label: style:too-many-theorem-like-statements
journal_style_gaps.reason: 158 theorem-like environments plus audit records are heavy for CICM presentation/workshop style.
journal_style_gaps.required_action: Foreground one theorem, one interface definition, one evidence table, and four case rows in the short paper.

journal_style_gaps.label: style:conditional-main-theorem-title
journal_style_gaps.reason: Readers may miss the record-gate-soundness hypothesis.
journal_style_gaps.required_action: Use a consistent title like Conditional finite-record audit theorem and list the hypotheses.

journal_style_gaps.label: style:bibliography-live-verification-needed
journal_style_gaps.reason: Live venue/bibliography verification is dated and may not match final submission date.
journal_style_gaps.required_action: Refresh before submission and update logs/manifest.

journal_style_gaps.label: style:source-path-heavy-prose
journal_style_gaps.reason: Long paths and digest details aid audit but impede workshop readability.
journal_style_gaps.required_action: Move dense path/hash material to tables or review-bundle references.

journal_style_gaps.label: style:abstract-supplement-role-clarity
journal_style_gaps.reason: Primary short article and long supplement roles must remain clear.
journal_style_gaps.required_action: Preserve package-shape convention and concise supplement note.

journal_style_gaps.label: style:terminology-record-gate-soundness
journal_style_gaps.reason: Local terms need a compact glossary for workshop readers.
journal_style_gaps.required_action: Add or preserve a short glossary/table in the primary article or opening supplement.
